Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members. This role will help build and evolve that foundation. The People Systems and Solutions Manager will partner with the Head of People Systems & Solutions, People leadership, and IT to shape and drive Apollo’s People Systems roadmap. You will translate People and business needs into clear requirements, lead multi-quarter systems and process initiatives, configure and improve platforms and workflows, and manage our People technology vendors. This is an individual contributor role today. You will lead through deep expertise, sound judgment, clear operating mechanisms, and influence rather than direct management authority. As the function evolves, the role may grow to include people management. jobs.desc: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry. We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels. If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. jobs.desc: Headquarters: Sarajevo, Bosnia And Herzegovina URL: http://blue-storm.co.uk Recruitment and Social Media Specialist We are a tech-first cleaning company based in London, and we are looking for a recruiter and social media specialist to join us during this growth period in 2024/2025. What You'll Do: Recruitment Excellence: Source, engage, and recruit top-tier candidates for various cleaning roles. Manage the recruitment lifecycle from job posting to onboarding. Contract Management: Create and manage contracts for cleaners, ensuring all legal documentation and valid work permits are in place for compliance with UK regulations. Social Media Savvy: Develop and execute engaging social media strategies across platforms like LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter to build our brand and attract potential candidates. Content Creation: Design eye-catching posts and campaigns using tools like Canva and CapCut. Craft compelling content that resonates with our audience and showcases our company culture. Analytics & Reporting: Monitor social media metrics and recruitment data to optimize strategies and improve our outreach efforts. Requirements You will be expected to be a team player and report to the Head of Operations Able to conduct many phone calls, WhatsApp messages, video calls, and emails each day Confident in Microsoft Office and Google Suite (including Docs, email, and Calendar) What We’re Looking For: Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and able to multi-task multiple projects Proven experience in recruitment and social media management. Strong proficiency with social media platforms and design/editing tools. Excellent communication skills and a knack for creating engaging content. A proactive and results-driven approach with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment. Confident in Microsoft Office and Google Suite (including Docs, email, and Calendar) You must be a person that wants to keep going till the job is delivered! What We Offer: Competitive Monthly Salary: Enjoy a great salary that reflects your skills and experience. Monthly Team Day: Join us for a day each month at our office with the full team (10 people), complete with lunch and drinks. Annual Luxury Retreat: Experience a high-end villa retreat in Sarajevo, featuring a private pool, BBQs, pool parties, live music, and plenty of beers! Supportive Team Environment: Work with a fantastic, family-friendly team that’s always supportive and collaborative. Performance-Based Promotions

jobs.desc: People Partner Hello, I’m Danielle, Senior Director, People Experience at Customer.io ! We're expanding our people team in the United States and seeking a People Partner to support our global team in a fast-paced, innovative environment. This is a great fit for an HR professional with a few years of experience who's ready to deepen their impact as a partner to the business. The People Partners at Customer.io are advocates for our people, leveraging their skills in data analytics, change management, and industry knowledge. They use these skills to enhance Customer.io ’s transformation, agility, and efficiency, delivering meaningful outcomes for both our team members and the business. You'll work alongside a cross-functional team to support talent management, development, retention, and organizational effectiveness. Strong communication, critical thinking, and a foundation in workforce planning will set you up for success. If you're passionate about contributing to a supportive, high-performing culture, we'd love for you to join our collaborative team. About Customer.io Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Some things you'll do: Support business alignment: Partner with departmental leaders to understand business needs and help develop plans that build organizational capabilities and support growth. Performance management: Own and elevate our review cycles end to end — lead the annual and bi-annual processes, guide calibration and compensation decisions, and coach managers to build accountability and develop talent across the team. Employee relations: Guide managers and employees through day-to-day questions and concerns with fairness and sound judgment, fostering a positive, respectful work environment. Organizational development: Help assess team structures and work with leaders to identify areas for improvement and put changes into practice. Change management support: Support organizational change efforts and help build change-readiness across teams. Leadership support: Build strong working relationships with managers to understand their needs in the context of business goals, and provide day-to-day partnership and guidance. Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together. What’s unique about this role? The Recruiting Coordinator assists in oversight of the full recruitment cycle on behalf of the Managed Review Recruiting and Operations functions, supports key employee lifecycle logistics, and serves as a champion for consistency and accuracy across all areas of responsibility. The Recruiting Coordinator functions as a shared service within Managed Review with flexibility and expertise to assist with PAC (People and Culture) functions as needed. What will this person do? Coordinates end-to-end processes for Managed Review candidates and new hires with attention to compliance, candidate experience, new hire experience, and efficiency. Ensures new hires are equipped to use employee-facing HRIS functions and are eligible to work in the U.S. Maintains candidate databases, while tracking recruitment metrics and ensuring compliance with HR policies. Supports Managed Review Recruitment by screening resumes, scheduling and conducting candidate interviews. Takes ownership of a smooth and positive candidate experience from interview to onboarding to assignment conclusion. Manages new hire paperwork while ensuring confidentiality and compliance with applicable laws. Writes, posts, and manages Managed Review job postings and job descriptions on career websites. Serves as point of contact for contract employee process. Identifies and acts upon process improvement in areas of responsibility, in coordination with recruiting team. Assists with implementation of Managed Review operations processes related to project initiation, set-up, and reporting. Collaborates and communicates with key stakeholders interdepartmentally related to Managed Review, talent acquisition, new hires, and other PAC related needs. Performs other duties as assigned.
